thread:
jessica-ops: sec-bot just alerted about a sampling spike in perm-proxy. looks like a batch of permission-change events were sampled out overnight, and many have missing actor fields. tagging @maria-sec @omar-sre @lia-compliance
sec-bot: ALERT: audit.sampling exceeded threshold namespace=perm-proxy sampled_out=42 sampling_rate=0.1 window=2026-03-19T23:00:00Z-2026-03-20T02:00:00Z
omar-sre: are these role grant/revoke events specifically? any sample event ids we can look at?
jessica-ops: sampled lines I pulled show event types role.grant / role.revoke. actor is often "<REDACTED>" or empty.
maria-sec: we shipped a redaction pass last week for PII. question: does redaction run before we write the audit index or after sampling? if before, it could be stripping actor.id that downstream indexing expects.
ethan-platform: redaction-service v1.4.2 rolled 2026-03-19T21:58:12Z. current pipeline: events -> redact-service -> sampling -> persist. that ordering could cause sampled-out events to have redacted actor metadata at sampling-time.
ethan-platform: sample raw line (simplified):
```
{"event":"role.update","id":"evt_01F...","actor":"<REDACTED>","target":"svc-123","change":"grant","role":"admin"}
```
lia-compliance: this is a SOC2 control break if we can't prove who made changes. we need count, window, and a plan to rehydrate or attest.
omar-sre: I can reconcile against perm-store (authoritative journal). rough SQL to find journal rows missing an audit_index entry:
```
SELECT j.tx_id, j.actor_id, j.target, j.change_ts, a.event_id
FROM perm_journal j
LEFT JOIN audit_index a ON a.tx_id = j.tx_id
WHERE a.event_id IS NULL
AND j.change_ts >= '2026-03-19 22:00:00+00'
AND j.change_ts <= '2026-03-20 03:00:00+00';
```
omar-sre: will run a sampled query first, post results in ~2h. will need write role to audit_index to rehydrate. filing infra ticket.
maria-sec: also consider KMS envelope metadata. if actor info was stored encrypted and redaction mangled ciphertext tags, we could lose mapping. redaction should preserve KMS metadata and tx_id fields.
ethan-platform: quick fix: add preserve_fields to redaction config so actor.id and tx_id are not altered. patch snippet we plan to deploy:
```
redaction:
  preserve_fields: ["tx_id","actor.id","role","change_ts"]
  pii_patterns: [...]
```
lia-compliance: if we can't fully rehydrate, we need an attestation and compensating controls (signed snapshots from perm-store, read-only digests). prepare template for auditors.
jessica-ops: proposed mitigation steps:
- hotfix redaction preserve_fields and deploy canary (no rollback)
- run omar's reconciliation and reindex missing events into audit_index
- add alert for audit.sampling > 0 for perm-* namespaces
- compliance to prepare exception attestation if needed
ethan-platform: I can push canary with preserve_fields in ~30m and validate that actor is retained in downstream index.
omar-sre: starting reconciliation now. will attach sample CSV and sha256 of rehydration bundle when ready. ETA: sample in 2h, full run 48h.
maria-sec: updating redaction policy to decrypt before redaction for internal audit streams and ensure KMS envelope metadata is retained. will add unit tests to prevent actor redaction. ETA EOD.
lia-compliance: timeline: if we get full reindex within 48h, compliance can accept recovered evidence. otherwise escalate to execs. I need counts and signed digests.
jessica-ops: I'll coordinate status updates and update the incident log. please keep all follow-ups in this thread. ping for infra ACL approvals. :thumbsup:
